about: Generated by engine/harness/fit_spell_values.py from spell_value_probe.py; do not hand-edit.
method: Positions from real engine self-play (round 4: every official spell drawn equally often). Each position is searched as played and again with one spell (or pair) made unusable for one side; the drop in that side's win probability is the spell's value there. Tier value = mean value per position of a game holding the spell (percentage points); matchup = value of A to one side minus value of B to the other; synergy = value of both to one side minus the two single values. Matchups favoured at >= 1 pp (strong >= 3), synergies at >= 0.5 pp (strong >= 1.5), each only when the 95% game-bootstrap interval excludes 0.
